verdict.rationale: The GitHub README advertises tracing and observability with real-time metrics, logs, and traces, and the docs describe an observability section covering execution times and token usage. CrewAI AMP also offers real-time monitoring of deployed crew execution, which implies a UI. However, nothing in the pack shows per-LLM-call and per-tool-invocation spans in a trace view. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-LLM-call and per-tool-call trace spans, documentation of the trace UI itself (open-source vs AMP-only), and independent hands-on corroboration.
